text: The sympathetic innervation for the gastrointestinal regions affected by this patient's condition originates from the thoracic and upper lumbar segments of the spinal cord (T5-L2). Specifically, preganglionic fibers to the celiac ganglion and superior mesenteric ganglion come from T5-T9, while those to the inferior mesenteric ganglion originate from L1-L2. CONFIDENCE: 85.
